bound.label: [EST] proven optimum: Sriamorn 2016, Thm 1.1

literature.source: K. Sriamorn, On the multiple packing densities of triangles, Discrete Comput. Geom. 55(1) (2016) 228-242
literature.proof: Theorem 1.1 with k = 1: delta_T(T) = delta_L(T) = 2/3 for every triangle T (the upper bound is proved there with stair polygons, secs. 4-5; Fary 1950 gives a lattice of density 2/3). A single piece on a torus is a lattice packing of it, so delta_L gives L = sqrt((sqrt3/4)/(2/3)) = sqrt(3 sqrt3/8) directly
literature.note: densest lattice packing of a triangle, density 2/3

literature.source: I. Fary, Sur la densite des reseaux de domaines convexes, Bull. Soc. Math. France 78 (1950) 152-161, Theoreme 1: the densest lattice packing of a convex domain has density >= 2/3, with equality only for triangles
literature.note: every convex domain has a lattice packing of density at least 2/3, denser unless it is a triangle; for a triangle this gives a lattice of density 2/3. The paper does not prove that no lattice packing of a triangle is denser (Sriamorn 2016 does)
